notes: There is no federal VAT. Sales tax is set by states and localities and does not apply to most services; set the rate your state requires, if any.

Self-employment tax is 15.3% (Social Security and Medicare) on 92.35% of net earnings; Alaska, Florida, Nevada, New Hampshire, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Washington and Wyoming have no broad state income tax on wages and self-employment earnings.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
